documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported its Q1 FY27 earnings where management highlighted challenges from global supply disruptions, raw material inflation, and weather uncertainties that later improved with a monsoon revival and government support. Despite external headwinds, the company achieved strong year-on-year growth in revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax, supported by backward integration and a diversified sourcing strategy. Management remains confident about capacity utilization ramp-ups and maintaining healthy margins through new NPK complex fertilizer product variants. Additionally, the company entered into a 10-year green ammonia agreement with SECI set to contribute starting in FY29. Krishana Phoschem Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial and operational performance, highlighting strong YoY growth in revenue and profit after tax driven by operational efficiencies and expanded capacities.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover growth over last year.
guidance.quote: We hope that we will be able to achieve our target for this year, which comes to around 25% of last year's revenue. So, your figure of 30%–35%, we can say that we will be able to achieve it.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than 500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: Management expects a top-line increase of approximately Rs. 500 crore, reaching between Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000 crore.
guidance.quote: So, you expect an increase of around Rs. 500 crore more, Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates overall revenue growth of 35% to 40% in FY27.
guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects to import approximately 150,000 metric tons of material in FY27.
guidance.quote: For FY27, based on market demand, we expect to import around 150,000 metric tons of material, which would translate into approximately Rs.1,000 crore of revenue.

guidance.claim: Benefits from the recent capacity expansion are expected to meaningfully reflect in performance from FY27 onwards.
guidance.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

demand_outlook.claim: Monsoon activity revived strongly in early July, cutting the all-India rainfall deficit.
demand_outlook.quote: Most importantly, monsoon activity revived strongly in early July, rapidly cutting the all-India rainfall deficit from nearly 40% at June and to approximately 24% by the first week of July.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and NBS support are expected to support fertilizer demand for the remainder of FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving in monsoon conditions, higher MSP and continued government support through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are expected to support the fertilizer demand during the remainder of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Kharif season demand appears constructive for the industry due to comfortable domestic stock levels and favorable monsoon forecasts.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: A stable agricultural environment and favorable monsoon outlook provide a constructive demand outlook.
demand_outlook.quote: On one hand, a stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure as any impact would first be absorbed by imports.
demand_outlook.quote: Even hypothetically, if demand were to soften, it is important to note that nearly 40% of phosphatic fertilizers are imported. Therefore, any impact would first be absorbed by imports, and domestic manufacturers would remain relatively insulated.

demand_outlook.claim: The industry concluded Q4 FY26 with comfortable inventory levels of 177 lakh metric tonne.
demand_outlook.quote: The industry concluded Q4 FY26 with comfortable inventory levels of 177 lakh metric tonne indicating balanced supply-demand conditions and healthy channel inventory levels.

capex_expansion.claim: Existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT with an additional 165,000 MT taking total capacity to 495,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar include NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: The company enhanced its NPK/DAP capacity by 50% to 495,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The company has entered a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: The recent expansion was funded through a mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capex_expansion.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly EBITDA stood at 89 crore, reflecting a 36% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: • Quarterly EBITDA stood at ₹ 89 crore, reflecting a 36% year-on-year growth, supported by disciplined cost management, despite volatility in raw material prices.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin is approximately 7% to 8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company has been able to pass on approximately 25% to 30% of the increase in input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Sulphur prices rose from around 65,000 to 70,000 per tonne in April to almost 1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
margins_costs.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly revenue grew 34.58 percent YoY to Rs 532.3 crore, driven by sustained capacity utilization and efficient execution across the integrated value chain.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly revenue grew 34.58% YoY to ₹532.3 crore, driven by sustained capacity utilization and efficient execution across our integrated value chain.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88 percent YoY to Rs 47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability is expected to decrease slightly during FY27 as the company absorbs some input cost increases.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, of course, we will absorb to some extent and as a result, our profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Global ammonia and sulphur prices firmed up towards the end of the quarter, creating cost pressure.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, ammonia prices moved up sequentially during the quarter. Sulphur prices also firmed up towards March. This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects margin pressure in the first quarter of FY27.
margins_costs.quote: While there may be some margin pressure in the first quarter, we expect margins to stabilize in the later part of the year as cost increases are passed on.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per ton on the manufacturing side was in the range of Rs. 5,500 in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: It was in the range of Rs.5,500 per ton.

margins_costs.claim: The trading business operates with an EBITDA margin of 5% to 6%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin is 5% to 6% in in trading business.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization for the quarter was 43% for the NPK-DAP unit and 121% for the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: • 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Fertilizer production reached 89,747 metric tonnes during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: • Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Certain NPK/DAP and SSP units operated above 100% capacity during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Maintained healthy utilization across NPK/DAP and SSP plants, with certain units operating above 100% capacity, reflecting strong demand and efficient plant operations

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production for the year reached 397,263 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: The company's rock phosphate beneficiation capacity is around 200,000 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: The beneficiation capacity is around 200,000 tons, and current utilization is in the range of 50% to 75%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split subdividing equity shares from 10 to 2 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's credit rating was upgraded to A+ (Stable) by CRISIL.
capital_allocation.quote: We are also pleased to highlight that our credit rating has been upgraded by CRISIL to A+ (Stable), reflecting improved financial strength and business fundamentals

capital_allocation.claim: The effective interest cost for the company ranges between 6% and 7.5%.
capital_allocation.quote: Overall, the effective interest cost is in the range of 6% to 7.5%.

capital_allocation.claim: Subsidy receivables stood at approximately Rs. 400 crore at the end of the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: So, subsidy receivable is almost Rs.400 crore and other receivables are in the range of Rs.300 crore to Rs.325 crore.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia and shipping lane uncertainties introduced considerable volatility to global fertilizer supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Prices of key inputs like ammonia and sulfur increased while phosphatic acid and rock phosphate prices remained elevated.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, prices of key inputs such as ammonia and sulfur increased, while phosphatic acid and rock phosphate prices also remained elevated, placing additional cost pressure on the industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties are identified as key monitorable risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry relies on imports for approximately 90% of key intermediates.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

management_commitments.claim: The green ammonia capacity agreement will start in FY29 after 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters.
management_commitments.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

management_commitments.claim: The new expansion is expected to stabilize over the next few months.
management_commitments.quote: As our Managing Director mentioned, our new expansion has already commenced production and is expected to stabilize over the next three to four months.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to receive green ammonia supply in approximately three years.
management_commitments.quote: As per the contract, the green ammonia plant is expected to commence operations in the third year, so we expect supply after approximately three years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
